title: John Wheeler's U diagram of the self-observing universe

tellings.quote: the the U with an where one tip of U is the big bang and the other tip is an eyeball staring back at the big bang

plain: A writer on precognition, Eric Wargo, describes a drawing by the physicist John Wheeler: a letter U where one tip is the Big Bang and the other tip is an eye staring back at it. Wargo uses it, along with ideas from the physicists Yakir Aharonov and John Cramer, to describe a universe that observes itself, with the future reaching back to shape the past. If so, it would help explain how people could dream of things before they happen.
